listing.name: Super Smash Bros. Melee / melee-pc
listing.summary: Explore Super Smash Bros. Melee / melee-pc and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Set up the upstream Android app
steps.instruction: Get Melee-Android-arm64.apk from the project's v0.4.2 release. Use an ARM64 device with Vulkan 1.1. In the upstream launcher, provide your own Super Smash Bros. Melee USA revision 2 disc image (GALE01). The project accepts ISO, GCM, CISO or RVZ. The touch overlay can be adjusted and hides when you use a physical controller.

warnings: Portcove has verified the package, but has not tested setup or Play on Android.
